summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (L13) proposing an experiment to test whether concurrent CD38-inhibitor + NAD-precursor dosing after senescent-cell/SASP clearance fails to exceed the better of two sequential dosing orders in terms of residual tissue ΔNAD. The card is classified as a research discussion with a negative status label, meaning the concurrent-vs-sequential-best head-to-head result is currently UNKNOWN and the experiment has NOT been run. All supporting evidence is drawn from published literature (TRL 1–2 level), with no original experimental data generated.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: After documented senescent-cell / SASP clearance, residual tissue ΔNAD from concurrent CD38-inhibitor + NAD-precursor at matched total exposure fails to exceed residual tissue ΔNAD from the better of the two sequential order arms (CD38i→precursor vs precursor→CD38i). Pre-registered as: residual_concurrent ≤ sequential_best + surplus_margin. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill' of the common longevity-stack practice of always co-dosing both agents simultaneously after senolysis.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: The 'subtract-before-add' framework: (1) Clear SASP-driven CD38+ macrophage load first via senolysis; (2) Run three matched-exposure arms — concurrent CD38i+precursor, sequential A (CD38i→precursor), sequential B (precursor→CD38i); (3) Score residual tissue ΔNAD against sequential_best = max(A, B). Key mechanistic priors: CD38 gates age-related NAD decline and NMN fate in vivo; SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain tissue NAD; senescent/SASP ablation lowers CD38 and partially restores NAD via an NMN-dependent ecto-block route; 78c-class CD38i improves aged-mouse healthspan as monotherapy. Incomplete clearance / residual CD38+ load can interact with schedule (concurrent vs sequential) — this interaction is predicted, not yet measured.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence Base
content_blocks.content:
Four key literature anchors are cited:
1. PMID 27304511 (Camacho-Pereira 2016, Cell Metab): Age NAD↓ requires CD38; CD38 gates NMN fate in vivo. Provides CD38–NAD / NMN-gating prior for residual assays.
2. PMID 33199924 (Covarrubias 2020, Nat Metab): SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that reduce tissue NAD. Provides subtract-before-add / incomplete-clearance motivation; NOT a concurrent-vs-sequential panel.
3. PMID 33199925 (Chini 2020, Nat Metab): Senescent/SASP ablation ↓CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD via NMN-dependent process. Post-clearance baseline prior, NOT concurrent vs sequential-best H2H.
4. PMID 35263032 (Tarragó 2022, Aging Cell): CD38i 78c increases lifespan/healthspan in chronological aging. Monotherapy tool prior, NOT concurrent vs sequential panel after senolysis.
Additional adjacent references noted as non-matches: PMID 33871064 (CD38i+NR co-treatment without senolysis order), PMID 36678315 (synergistic-stack review), PMID 41021886 (doxorubicin 78c–NMN).

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured vs. Unknown
content_blocks.content:
MEASURED (literature): CD38 gates age NAD/NMN fate; SASP→CD38+ macrophages→tissue NAD↓; clearance ↓CD38 + partial NAD rebound; ecto-block NMN-dependent; 78c aged-mouse benefit as monotherapy.
UNKNOWN: Matched H2H concurrent vs sequential-best residual ΔNAD after senolysis (soft-complete concurrent∩sequential∩senolytic = 0; adjacent co-treatment PMIDs are non-matches).
PREDICTION: Concurrent-fails-to-exceed.
Key distinctions: L9 ≠ this (stack surplus ≠ concurrent vs sequential-best); L12 left concurrent open (order asymmetry ≠ concurrent residual vs sequential-best); L5–L12 ≠ proof; co-treatment ≠ this panel.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat L5–L12 as proving L13 — ranking/stack surplus/duals/sequential order asymmetry never ran matched concurrent vs sequential-best residual ΔNAD after clearance; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated concurrent-failure.
2. Co-treatment ≠ concurrent-vs-sequential-best — concurrent CD38i+NR without senolysis order (e.g. PMID 33871064) or synergistic-stack reviews (PMID 36678315) do not report concurrent vs max(sequential A, B) residual ΔNAD after matched senolytic/SASP run-in.
3. L9 ≠ L13; L12 ≠ L13; incomplete clearance/target-load may interact with schedule; Chini clearance/ecto-block and 78c monotherapy are not this panel; no dosing specified.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered concurrent-vs-sequential-best residual panel after verified clearance, residual_concurrent exceeds sequential_best = max(residual_CD38i_then_precursor, residual_precursor_then_CD38i) outside the pre-registered surplus_margin (concurrent DOES beat better sequential), when CD38↓ is verified — especially under incomplete clearance, exposure mismatch, or when apparent concurrent-failure is only an assay-definition artifact.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design (Ask a Human)
content_blocks.content:
Required design elements before claiming concurrent fails to exceed sequential-best after senolysis:
- Lock tissue or cell system (prefer SASP-conditioned macrophage / WAT or liver explant before whole-animal)
- Clearance verification (CD38 activity + SC/SASP marker)
- Matched total exposure for concurrent CD38i (78c-class) + NAD precursor (NMN/NR-class) vs sequential arms A/B
- Residual ΔNAD definition (nmol/mg or fold vs post-clearance baseline)
- Pre-specify α, N, and surplus_margin before running
- Do not treat L5–L12 as proof; L9≠this; L12 left concurrent open; co-treatment ≠ this panel; no dosing specified.

key_findings: Hypothesis L13 is classified STATUS_LABEL: NEGATIVE and execution_status = NOT_RUN — no original experimental data has been generated; this is a proposed assay at TRL 1.
The critical variable 'matched_concurrent_vs_sequential_best_H2H_panel' is explicitly UNKNOWN — a systematic search found zero papers with concurrent∩sequential∩senolytic design (soft-complete = 0).
All four mechanistic priors are literature-confirmed (PMIDs 27304511, 33199924, 33199925, 35263032) but none constitute a concurrent-vs-sequential-best head-to-head panel after senolysis.
The core claim — concurrent CD38i+NAD-precursor residual ΔNAD ≤ sequential_best after senolysis — is a PREDICTION, not an observed result.
Adjacent co-treatment studies (PMID 33871064, 36678315, 41021886) are explicitly identified as non-matches for the H2H design.
Estimated time to refute: 6 weeks; kill_cost_tier = 2; preferred model is SASP-conditioned macrophage or WAT/liver explant before whole-animal.
FTO status is UNKNOWN; IP class is 'subtract-before-add'; vault_hold = no.
Distinct from related cards L9 (stack surplus ≠ concurrent vs sequential-best) and L12 (order asymmetry left concurrent OPEN); L5–L12 ranking/duals do not prove L13.
